title: THREAD
text: THREAD (Trait Heterogeneity Regression Expression Annotation Dirichlet processes) R package integrating LD-corrected gene-level GWAS response statistics gene--cellular-label expression profiles. THREAD infers latent gene modules estimates module-specific cellular coefficients heteroscedastic Bayesian nonparametric model. package supports modular workflow. Users can start raw GWAS single-cell inputs, externally prepared SNP--gene map, existing gene-level response, directly prepared THREAD model object.

title: THREAD
text: THREAD provides: preprocessing GWAS summary statistics; aggregation single-cell expression gene--cellular-label matrix; SNP--gene mapping using annotated gene body plus configurable genomic window; LD-aware construction gene-level response heteroscedastic variance terms; SNP-name chromosome-position matching modes; automatic reciprocal completion symmetrization sparse LD records; trace-preserving PSD repair eigenvalue clipping; gene2vec-based k-means-based initialization; Bayesian Dirichlet process mixture fitting; posterior-similarity-based gene partitioning; frequentist Bayesian module-cellular-label inference; downstream gene cellular-label prioritization scores.

Gene modules inferred Dirichlet process mixture.
